ns2:section.sectionTitle: What can I do with a BS in IB
ns2:section.sectionText: 1 hour. Title: What can I do with a BS in IB? RESTRICTED TO IB MAJORS. This weekly seminar will explore a range of life sciences careers and strategies students can use to learn about them and develop their skills and experience in order to prepare for them. S/U grading based on: Participation in the weekly discussions & class activities led by SIB alumni, SIB faculty & UIUC career resouce personnel, and a final career presentation.
